question: The Thrissur Pooram festival of Kerala is held _______ at the Vadakkunnathan Temple in Thrissur town.
solution:
The correct answer is __**annually.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Thrissur Pooram is an** annual temple festival clasp in Thrissur, Kerala, India.**
 
• It is a clasp at the Vadakkunnathan (Shiva) Temple in Thrissur **annually** on Pooram day.
 
• The day during the moon rises with the **Pooram star in the Malayalam Calendar month of Medam.**
 
• The carnival was begun by** Raja Rama Varma, Maharaja of Cochin Sakthan Thampuran in ******1798****.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• However the presiding deity at Thiruvambadi is **Lord Krishna**, it is the second in the significant deity of Goddess Bhagavati that participates in the pooram. 
 
• There are as well eight other temples participate, but some exclusive rights as part of **pooram** are vested with** Paramekkavu and Thiruvambadi temples.**
